prompt: Same fixture. User confirms --merge for the RSC / React Server Components pair only. Merge them carefully.
expected_output: Confirmed manual merge: canonical absorbs secondary title as alias, secondary deleted (no redirect stub), vault-wide wikilinks rewritten, index/hot/manifest updated.

assertions.text: Asks for explicit yes/skip/review confirmation per merge pair before writing; skips on anything other than yes
Reads both pages in full, then merges via Edit/Write tools only — no scripts or automated merge commands
Canonical page aliases absorb the secondary title; secondary file is deleted — no redirects_to: stub created
Vault-wide wikilinks rewritten from secondary slug to canonical slug (skipping code fences and frontmatter)
Updates index.md, hot.md Recent Activity, and .manifest.json merged_into / pages lists after the merge
When the vault is a standalone Git repo, takes a pre-write snapshot and aborts all writes if the snapshot fails
